question: P is any point inside the rectangle ABCD. If PA = 100 cm, PB = 76 cm, and PC = 85 cm, then the length PD (in cm) is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the British Flag Theorem for a point inside a rectangle: PA² + PC² = PB² + PD²

⇒ 100² + 85² = 76² + PD²

⇒ 10000 + 7225 = 5776 + PD²

⇒ 17225 = 5776 + PD²

⇒ PD² = 11449 ⇒ PD = √11449 = 107

**∴ The correct answer is 107 cm.**
